title: Pinch Zoom
description: Hai điểm chạm tách xa nhau, thẻ nội dung phóng to quanh tâm hai ngón, vượt quá một chút rồi lắng lại và thẳng ra.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio pinch-zoom, written here): Card 62 % x 58 % r10 (gradient), two touch points 14 px (white ring) at 27 % from each side. Over 820 ms (each segment eased in-out): card scale 0.72 → 1.32 at 72 % → 1.18 at 100 %, rotate −3° → 2° → 0; the touch points move outward ±45 px by 72 % then ease back to ±34.5 px (scale follows the finger gap). Recipe: scale = current gap / start gap, clamped 1-3, origin at the pinch centre. Params: scale (0.72 → 1.32 → 1.18) · fingers (±45 → ±34.5 px) · duration (0.82 s) · ease (power2.inOut từng đoạn). Scale 0.72 → 1.32 at 72 % → 1.18 and a small turn; the fingers move apart ±45 then ease back (in a product: scale = current gap / start gap).
